States.note: All five states in one column: checked (bg-primary + Check indicator), unchecked, indeterminate, and both disabled variants at reduced opacity. The state axis genuinely varies; indeterminate shows the DS's actual (unstyled-background) treatment rather than an invented one.

WithLabel.note: Stateful useState wrapper paired with a real Label via htmlFor — the registry's CheckboxDemo composition with product copy.

PermissionList.note: Four-row tool-permission list in a surface-elevated card with per-row Label + text-ui-sm detail, two checked and two unchecked from real state. Plausible settings composition, nothing collapsed.
